raw.details:
Expanding Horizon 8.0 – Electrical Engineering (EE)

Organized by: Student Mentorship Program (SMP), MNNIT Allahabad

Expanding Horizon 8.0 – EE is an initiative by the Student Mentorship Program (SMP), MNNIT Allahabad, designed to help aspiring electrical engineers assess and strengthen their technical preparation for the upcoming internship season.

The assessment focuses on fundamental concepts and problem-solving abilities across major areas of Electrical Engineering, providing participants with an opportunity to evaluate their conceptual clarity and technical aptitude.

Objectives

  • Evaluate fundamentals of Electrical Machines.
  • Strengthen understanding of Power Systems.
  • Assess knowledge of Electrical Circuits and Network Theory.
  • Test concepts related to Control Systems.
  • Evaluate understanding of Power Electronics.
  • Encourage analytical and application-based problem-solving.

Guidelines

  • The assessment will be conducted online through Unstop.
  • Participants must complete the assessment within the stipulated time.
  • Submissions will be evaluated based on predefined criteria.
  • Any unfair practice or plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  • The decision of the organizing team will be final.

Power Your Knowledge. Strengthen Your Fundamentals.
